We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What are we looking for? Were looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to join our team and help us build products that are reliable, scalable, and easy to evolve. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding engineers, and making sound technical decisions in a practical way. Youll work with Java, Spring Boot, and Vue.js, helping the team deliver quality software, improve existing systems, and balance speed with long-term maintainability and stability. What youll be doing Leading the team from a technical perspective Helping design and build scalable, maintainable solutions Working closely with product, design, and engineering teams Mentoring developers and supporting their growth Improving development standards and code quality Identifying risks early and helping the team manage them Contributing to technical direction and product evolution Supporting production stability and continuous improvement What youll need to know/have A strong software engineering background, with solid experience in senior-level roles Proven experience leading technical decisions and supporting team delivery (hands-on approach to technical leadership) Strong backend experience with Java / Spring Boot Solid experience with Vue.js Good understanding of software architecture in complex environments, APIs, databases (SQL, NoSQL, etc.), and production environments A strong focus on clean code, quality, and maintainability Experience with CI/CD, testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices Experience working in Agile teams Familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence Professional English level (intermediate/advanced) Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders Interest in modern technologies, including AI/ML or GenAI, is a plus Whats in it for you:  Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys;  Electronic Meal Tickets   Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;  #WFH & Flexible hours;  Professional GSM subscription;  Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];  Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;  Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;  Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen;  Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.  Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.     At Orange, you can.  IMPORTANT  In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.  We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
